principle: Use paid API keys only as optional accelerators. Core fixtures, historical results, team context, weather, model training and QA must keep working from free/open sources.

sources.name: Football-Data.co.uk
sources.risk: Not a live odds feed; update cadence is periodic and league coverage varies.

sources.name: OpenFootball / football.db
sources.risk: Historical/open data is strong; current fixture completeness differs per competition.

sources.name: TheSportsDB Free API
sources.risk: Free API has stricter limits and some methods are restricted compared with premium.

sources.name: OpenLigaDB
sources.risk: Community-maintained data; validate before using as single source of truth.

sources.name: StatsBomb Open Data
sources.risk: Excellent quality but selected competitions only and not live.

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.cost: free for non-commercial use within limits
sources.risk: Free tier is non-commercial and attribution/rate-limit rules apply.

sources.name: FiveThirtyEight Soccer SPI
sources.risk: Sports forecasts are no longer actively updated, so use as historical benchmark only.

fallbackOrder: Football-Data.co.uk for historical training and market calibration
TheSportsDB free API for club metadata and fixture fallback
StatsBomb Open Data for advanced historical feature engineering
FiveThirtyEight SPI only as historical benchmark

notRecommendedAsPrimary.reason: High fragility, legal/terms risk and inconsistent source timestamps.
They reintroduce credential dependency and can silently expire.
